title: The nest route that a memstore rejection names builds as written
proves: a readback without count, with the producer count or above it reads every producer row once and is ready
the nest route names the max_count value and the count scope; a nested braces count names the parent's fields bare, and parent.<field> in the count fails

negatives.name: subset_readback_names_max_count_and_the_count_scope
negatives.remediation: Its value is the rows of all products together; 2000 is safe. The braces count runs in the parent row, so it names the parent's fields bare, count="{1 if id % 2 == 1 else 0}"; only the child's keys write parent.<field>.
